title: release: add artifact signing, SBOM generation, provenance and release manifests for private-installer CI
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: Improve security and traceability of Private Installer releases by producing signed artifacts, SBOMs, and machine-readable release/provenance manifests as part of CI. This makes air-gapped installs auditable and supports compliance workflows. Summary of changes: - Add GitHub Actions workflows to build release artifacts, generate SBOMs (syft), and sign artifacts with cosign. - Produce per-release JSON/YAML release-manifests containing artifact URLs, digests, cosign signatures, SBOM location, build metadata (git sha, build agent, timestamp), and Linear/Jira references. - Integrate manifest publishing into existing S3 release bucket + make manifests available via release-manifests/<release>/manifest.json and manifest.sig. - Update Helm chart packaging step to include chart provenance and a charts/ index entry pointing at signed tarballs. - Bump Terraform module version references used by private-installer to match signed images and add an upgrade_manifest generator for automated rolling upgrades/rollbacks. - Update release documentation and add a release checklist (signing keys, KMS usage, offline verification steps). Checklist: - [x] Add syft invocation and SBOM upload step - [x] Add cosign signing & upload + cosign key lookup via KMS - [x] Emit release-manifest JSON with provenance fields - [x] Update Helm packaging job to attach provenance and include signed charts - [x] Add upgrade/rollback manifest generator script - [x] Add migration notes to docs Important notes and operational changes: - Signing: uses cosign with keys stored in AWS KMS (customer-managed in Private deployments). CI uses a short-lived signing key per run; release manifests include cosign public key material and key-id. - SBOMs: syft produces SPDX JSON and cyclonedx; both are uploaded alongside artifacts. - Verification: added lightweight verify_release.sh that performs digest and signature checks using cosign and compares SBOM SPDX/package lists to expected manifest. - Rollbacks: upgrade_manifest includes previous-release pointers and a preflight checksum to allow safe rollback. - Backwards compatibility: existing release consumers that only download tarballs continue to work. New consumers may choose to validate signatures/SBOMs. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4821 (release automation), OPS-119 (oncall verification). Links: docs/release/README.md for verification steps. Migration instructions: release engineers must configure KMS keys in repo secrets (README updated) and grant CI role cosign permission. Testing notes: tested end-to-end in staging: artifacts built, signed, SBOMs generated, manifests uploaded and validated. CI passed after two reruns due to transient network to S3. Security review: Priya ran a quick audit on key handling and recommended rotating the short-lived signing keys every release and recording key IDs in the manifest.

review_conversation: Jonah Reyes (reviewer): Overall looks solid. Please ensure the cosign key rotation docs are explicit for on-prem customers where KMS may be outside AWS.
Elena Park (author): Added a note in docs/release/README.md recommending customer-managed KMS and included sample IAM/KMS policy. Also added key-id field to manifest.
Priya Singh (security): Small nit: avoid writing private key material to logs. Please add masking and confirm syft doesn't leak secrets via environment variables.
Elena Park: Confirmed. CI masks keys and syft runs in a read-only container; added extra masking in workflow. Updated workflow to remove any debug output before signing.
Marcus Liu (approver): Verified staging end-to-end. SBOMs and signatures validate. Approving for merge.
CI Bot: All checks passed (build, unit tests, lint). One transient failure retried.
release_notes: Produce signed release artifacts and SBOMs for Private Installer releases. Adds release-manifest JSON with artifact digests, cosign signatures, SBOM locations, and build provenance. CI now publishes signed artifacts to S3 and provides verify_release.sh for local verification. Documentation updated with key rotation and offline verification steps.
notes: Operators must add COSIGN_KMS_KEY and COSIGN_KMS_KEY_ID to repository secrets for future releases.
Staging successfully validated: signed artifacts + SBOMs uploaded and verified via verify_release.sh.
Follow-up PR planned to integrate GPG signing for legacy consumers (ENG-4902).
